title: Daily Summary — 2026-04-29
body:
## Recent Activity

Active day focused on two feature areas: activating giscus comments and improving dark mode. The Sepo agent infrastructure was also merged yesterday. Key loop: sepo-agent analyzed #18 → opened PR #20 → PR flagged for `.agent/dist/` bloat → lolipopshock asked for a `/fix-pr` cleanup (in-flight).

## Recently Active PRs

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#17](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/17) — **MERGED** `chore: install Sepo agent infrastructure` — large infra drop (`.agent/`, workflows, actions, prompts). Merged 2026-04-28.

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#20](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/20) — **OPEN** `feat: activate giscus comments with live repo and category IDs` (agent-authored, closes #18). Substantive change is one line in `quartz.layout.ts`; however the PR accidentally includes 456 files from `.agent/dist/` (compiled artifacts). lolipopshock asked for `/fix-pr` to strip the dist files and add `.agent/dist/` to `.gitignore`.

## Recently Active Issues

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#18](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/18) — **OPEN** `Add giscus to our codebase` — sepo-agent confirmed giscus is fully wired up; only the `repoId`/`categoryId` placeholders needed replacing. Agent implemented the fix in PR #20. Still open pending PR merge.

- [augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io#19](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/issues/19) — **OPEN** `Better dark mode support` — sepo-agent identified two problems: (1) `--episode-card-bg` is hardcoded to `#fffefc` in `custom.scss:55`, making episode pages nearly unreadable in dark mode (critical); (2) `box-shadow` values use hardcoded dark colors that are invisible on dark backgrounds (cosmetic). A fix plan was posted; no implementation requested yet.

## Recently Active Discussions

No discussions were synced in this window.

## Follow-ups

1. **Review and merge PR #20** after the `/fix-pr` agent run completes — confirm `.agent/dist/` is in `.gitignore` and the diff is down to `quartz.layout.ts` only, then merge to activate giscus.
2. **Act on issue #19** — the sepo-agent analysis is ready; trigger `/implement` (or answer the open design questions about shadow vs. border treatment) to fix dark mode on episode pages before more content ships.
